detail:
- **Documented**: 103 of 228 modules carry an author's summary

66 requirements: 39 checked and 27 refuted.
quotes: http
Http is the module that defines the HTTP server entry point used to run the application, invoked from both the Firebase function bundle and the standalone serve script.
node-adapter
Documented the Node-adapter module as a platform-specific adapter with no further detail available.
server
The Server module provides the application's server entry point, with no further requirements recorded yet.
get-component
A server-side function module that looks up and returns a single design system component's data for the MCP server to serve to an agent.
get-component-docs
Provides an MCP tool handler that retrieves documentation for a specific design system component once it has been matched.
get-component-stories
Documents the MCP tool module that retrieves a component's Storybook stories, guarded by a handler that requires a resolved component match before running.
get-patterns
Module providing MCP pattern lookup functionality that exposes a getPatterns operation for retrieving design system usage patterns, used by the MCP server's tool layer.
get-rules
Provides an MCP tool handler that retrieves the design system's shared rules for an AI agent assembling a piece.
get-template
A thin MCP tool wrapper function that fetches template data by delegating to shared logic for exposure through the MCP server.
get-template-stops
Implements the MCP tool handler that returns a template's stops by looking up the template's shared data and validating it exists before responding.
get-tokens
A small module that retrieves shared design tokens for use elsewhere in the system.
list-components
Documents the List-components module, a build/MCP metadata script exposing a single listComponents operation that draws on shared code to enumerate the design system's components.
